items.Sentence: The General Order states in Section B.2.d that septic tanks shall be pumped when any of the following conditions exists:
The Discharge shall comply with all pond system requirements specified in Section B.5 of the General Order.

RV, portable toilet, or similar wastes shall not be discharged to a septic tank or functionally equivalent system (e.g., Imhoff tank) without subsequent additional treatment (e.g., aerated pond, recirculating sand filter, etc.) prior to disposal.
